facts.fact: 蛇蜕之喻：Nikolas 想母亲——七岁把蛇蜕放上母亲膝头（南方 Vaega 出生的她不退缩）——「那不是蛇，是它脱下的皮。蛇长大了、皮不会长——所以必须蜕。When you outgrow them, or if they become too tattered to wear, you have no need of them anymore. You find something new.」；跪在 Divine City 中央——「他是否在蜕去旧皮、为别的东西腾地方？」
facts.anchor: When you outgrow them, or if they become too tattered to wear

facts.fact: 白翼破体（续）：翅膀压他下跪——「more wings—smaller, longer, outspreading——劈开肋、上臂、大腿的皮肤」「He was fraying. He was frayed. Had he ever been whole?」；「Soon enough he'd be in two pieces: his destroyed flesh, and his exoskeleton. 也许 Phos 的计划一向如此：把他变成又一只顺从的兽、流放于无尽沙漠」；「细如骨的翼半径自眼窝推出、绽开白金羽扇」
facts.anchor: his destroyed flesh, and his exoskeleton

facts.fact: 神的低语与 Rian 出发：「Come and kneel before me.」；Julian 报 gates 异动而去「Keep him safe.」（手带土与晒暖草香=Fin）；Edwin「stop him? There is absolutely no conceivable way…」——南望「鸣响示警的巨塔」——「There may be something we can do. I need your assistance. As this requires a Lumin, and the other one is… indisposed.」；Rian 握兄手——羽自指间绽出缠腕（徒劳的挽留）「I have to do something. Find cover until I come back. Fin, watch over him.」；Nikolas 心中三连「Don't go. Stay here. Let me protect you.」——Phos 叹「I can offer you the means with which to protect him, Nikolas. But first, you must come to me.」；「I am not yours,」他咆哮；Fin「That's it, Sunshine. Keep resisting.」——「Caught between two orders, Nikolas knew which one he would follow.」

「Kill the ones I don't」：Julian 弃 Orsus 提议——glyph 箭爆烟硫散阵；恶魔之力近战（砸碎头骨、蒸汽喷口、脏器炭化）——「He smiled. Pathetic, Orsus murmured. This mindless feast of violence?」；救 Taesia 盲区——「血是温的……皮化金灰、viscera 挂袖」；她眼中惊愕「Julian……」（盯眼与爪——恶魔本就缝在他花纹里的部分）——舔血「尝起来像余烬」；「She did not look away or waver. Her voice was low with want. Kill the ones I don't.」——「他是自由的恶魔、无召唤者——命令却照样点燃他」

Taesia 揭 Faün：「他们的命从没重要过，对吧？I've seen your dreams, Faün ost Vonlin. 我知你的怕与不安——你想胜过 Varrick、想证明 Solara 之威、想名字被万口传颂（无论爱憎）——你以为自己能成神，而 Phos 只当你是 lapdog. Because your life never really meant much to him.」——熔金裂纹爬上 Faün 的脸

选已知的恶：Faün 召 volucris（镰爪白首）「The Sunslayer will fall by my hand.」；Dante 拉他入影「What we did in Nexus. In the palace square. We have to do it again.」——见角一震「The more I use the demon's power, the more I…」「There's no time. When the volucris land, we attack.」；「Would Julian end up with horns?……What use do they have for a monster? Orsus whispered. There are other ways to exert your will.」——「变成更多的恶魔，或变成神的玩物——仅有的两个选项」；「Kill the ones I don't——信任他、接纳他。若必须选一种恶来共处，他选他已认识的那一个」
facts.anchor: Become more of the demon, or become more of a god’s plaything

facts.fact: Orsus 夺身：右肩被 Azideh 按住——骨镯「Enough.」——右臂麻痹、不受控举起——「Orsus's will superseded his. Stop!」——指尖红光、声音被封；「Orsus 强迫他画出远比以往复杂的 Conjuration circle——中央六芒星」；snap 指尖——「Reality rippled. 他能解析万物中的 quintessence 丝缕——地、墙、天空；北升的太阳也只是一团凝聚的 aether」「How else do you think the realms were formed?……Through me, all is possible.」
facts.anchor: Orsus forced him to sketch out a Conjuration circle.

facts.fact: 拆解与活埋：「Orsus 抓住 volucris 周身的丝缕——兽不过是物质与魔法——一拽 unraveled：翼在无风之风中碎裂、躯体内翻露出跳动的器官；再一拽——如旧纱般纺散」；「地砖 melting——把军团连同鎏金首领吸入泥沼；他们宁可烧尽自己的力量也不受这耻辱死法」；「Faün 的 wild eyes 转向神殿『Lord Daystar!』——神没有回应」；「general 的难以置信是 Julian 最后看见的——Buried alive, encased within stone.」；「What did you do?」（Dante 望着他「仿佛 Julian 才是变成别的什么的那一个」）；Taesia 沉默同问——「她认得恶魔，唯独这一面——矛盾——她还看不透」；「He felt—violated, exposed, changed in a way far worse than anything the demon could have done. 因为他终于、可悲地接受了旁人一直告诉他的事实：他是第五位 heir——与他的神的关系，和他们对各自的神一样：棋子」
